# code-preview

## Plugin reference

- Description: Registry of code previews keyed by fence language: a CodePreview.Renderer contribution ({ lang, aliases, label, Component }) draws a language's source as what it describes — a mermaid fence as its diagram. Consumers (markdown fences, the page code block) read it only through useCodePreviewRenderer / useCodePreviewLangs, so a new language needs no consumer change; CodePreviewError is the shared failure chrome.
- Web:
  - Slots: `CodePreview.Renderer`
  - Slot contributors: `CodePreview.Renderer` ← `primitives.syntax-highlight.code-preview.mermaid`
  - Uses:
    - `primitives/css/spacing.Stack`
    - `primitives/css/text.Text`
  - Exports (types): `CodePreviewRendererContribution`
  - Exports (values):
    - `CodePreview`
    - `CodePreviewError`
    - `useCodePreviewLangs`
    - `useCodePreviewRenderer`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Uses tokens:
    - `ui/tokens/density --space-md`
    - `ui/tokens/density --space-sm`
  - Imported by:
    - `page/code-block`
    - `primitives/markdown`
    - `primitives/syntax-highlight/code-preview/mermaid`
- Sub-plugins:
  - **`mermaid`** — Mermaid as a code preview: a mermaid fence (in markdown, or a page code block set to mermaid) drawn as its diagram — lazy-loaded, themed from the surrounding theme tokens, with the parse error shown…
